definitions.overall_shape: REASONABLE: recognizable structurally complete bench with main seating body and support organization; INCOMPLETE: a major body/support is absent, torn apart or incompatible; UNCERTAIN when views do not settle it. Does not require source style, watertightness or one connected component.
definitions.C_use: PLAUSIBLE: C participates in a plausible functional relation to the generated body; REPLACED_OR_IGNORED: a separate gray substitute displaces its apparent role or C remains an unrelated floating insert; UNCERTAIN if ambiguous. Exact shared edges are not required by this visual axis. Mere blue visibility is insufficient.
definitions.support_retention: PRESENT requires substantial coherent intended support surfaces or coherent intentional rods/frames. MISSING_OR_DAMAGED if only torn shells, open narrow remnants or displaced scraps remain. A small local opening does not automatically mean major support loss; count such openings separately. UNCERTAIN if occlusion or framing prevents judgment.
definitions.visible_fragment_or_gap: YES for visible loose scraps, abnormal tears or separation; NO_OBVIOUS only if neither view nor section provides clear evidence. Section endpoints alone do not prove holes: cross-check full views. Designed slat spacing and ordinary separate assembly parts are not automatically defects.
definitions.layering_or_fold: YES for visibly redundant layers, obvious interpenetrating/folded sheets or a competing seat; NO_OBVIOUS when none is visible; UNCERTAIN for occluded ambiguous thin layers. Do not infer this label from numerical conflict scores.

reference_review_policy: Review EXPOSURE anew on the same comparison pages. Historical labels are not copied into this experiment.

assignment_order: Frozen manifest request order, slices [0:16], [16:31], [31:46]; all stages and models of each request assigned together.
rules: Read both oblique views and both original fixed sections for each of the three model rows on every page.
Record all five axes independently and one concrete visual note for every model-stage cell.
Allow UNCERTAIN only as an actual view judgment; missing views remain pending, never defaulted to NO_OBVIOUS or UNCERTAIN.
No metric-derived labels, no source-style reconstruction grading, no forced watertightness or single connected component.
Distinguish coherent intentional thin supports and designed slat spacing from torn/open remnants; section endpoints alone do not prove holes.
Reviewer identity, actual view tool/event, UTC time, image SHA256 and gallery receipt SHA256 are mandatory for completed records.
Image framing or occlusion limits must be noted; generated images alone do not count as completed review.
Nonblind AI_PROXY observations are not independent human assessment.
Historical anchor views and prior dataset reviews are historical provenance only; zero prior ratings are copied.
Do not select requests, models or stages by numeric scores or generated outcomes.
Keep protocol, assignments and blank templates immutable; save actual completed reviews separately.
